data.title: Leash order for your dog "Bruno"
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt public order office (Ordnungsamt) ordered, on 15 May 2025, that your dog must be kept on a leash of at most two metres outside your enclosed property, effective immediately. A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €250 is threatened for violations.
data.explanation: The city issued an order after an incident on 28 April 2025 in which your dog jumped at a passer-by. From now on, outside your own fenced property, your dog must be on a leash of at most two metres. If you break the rule, a coercive fine of €250 can be imposed. You may challenge the order by filing a court action (Klage) at the administrative court; there is no objection procedure (Widerspruch). The app shows the deadline for filing. The order applies while any challenge is pending, so keep the leash rule. Consider seeking legal advice if you want to challenge it.

items.title: File court action against leash order (optional)
items.action: If you want to challenge the order, file a court action (Klage) in writing or on record at the Administrative Court of Musterstadt by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.

items.title: Keep dog on a leash of max. 2 metres
items.action: Keep your dog on a leash of at most two metres outside your enclosed property, starting immediately.
items.consequence: A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €250 is threatened for violations.
